entries.subject: Exalted

spans.text: "Exalted is He who has subjected this to us, and we could not have [otherwise] subdued it.
Indeed, man is clearly ungrateful.

entries.task_id: of them|is|given good tidings of that which he attributes to the most merciful in comparison
entries.description: of them is given good tidings of that which he attributes to the Most Merciful in comparison
entries.subject: of them
entries.object: given good tidings of that which he attributes to the Most Merciful in comparison

spans.text: [17] AR: وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُم بِمَا ضَرَبَ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ مَثَلًۭا ظَلَّ وَجْهُهُۥ مُسْوَدًّۭا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ EN: And when one of them is given good tidings of that which he attributes to the Most Merciful in comparison, his face becomes dark, and he suppresses grief.

entries.task_id: so|is|one brought up in ornaments while being during conflict unevident [attributed to allah]?
entries.description: So is one brought up in ornaments while being during conflict unevident [attributed to Allah]?
entries.subject: So
entries.object: one brought up in ornaments while being during conflict unevident [attributed to Allah]?

spans.text: [18] AR: أَوَمَن يُنَشَّؤُا۟ فِى ٱلْحِلْيَةِ وَهُوَ فِى ٱلْخِصَامِ غَيْرُ مُبِينٍۢ EN: So is one brought up in ornaments while being during conflict unevident [attributed to Allah]?

[20] AR: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْ شَآءَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ مَا عَبَدْنَٰهُم ۗ مَّا لَهُم بِذَٰلِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَخْرُصُونَ EN: And they said, "If the Most Merciful had willed, we would not have worshipped them."

entries.task_id: see how|was|the end of the deniers
entries.description: see how was the end of the deniers
entries.subject: see how

spans.text: [25] AR: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ ۖ فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ EN: So we took retribution from them; then see how was the end of the deniers.

entries.task_id: when abraham|said|to his father and his people
entries.description: when Abraham said to his father and his people
entries.subject: when Abraham
entries.object: to his father and his people

spans.text: [26] AR: وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦٓ إِنَّنِى بَرَآءٌۭ مِّمَّا تَعْبُدُونَ EN: And [mention, O Muhammad], when Abraham said to his father and his people, "Indeed, I am disassociated from that which you worship

[30] AR: وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ قَالُوا۟ هَٰذَا سِحْرٌۭ وَإِنَّا بِهِۦ كَٰفِرُونَ EN: But when the truth came to them, they said, "This is magic, and indeed we are, concerning it, disbelievers."

entries.task_id: why|was|this qur'an not sent down upon a great man from [one of] the two cities?"
entries.description: Why was this Qur'an not sent down upon a great man from [one of] the two cities?"
entries.subject: Why
entries.object: this Qur'an not sent down upon a great man from [one of] the two cities?"

spans.text: [31] AR: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانُ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْقَرْيَتَيْنِ عَظِيمٍ EN: And they said, "Why was this Qur'an not sent down upon a great man from [one of] the two cities?"
